baseline_construction_method.value: Data-mining (CRISP-DM) workflow: 45 potential influence variables collected hourly; specific-consumption EPIs (SCPU/SCRU/SCDU) categorised into five groups and the influence variables normalised; Discriminant Function Analysis selected 14 key influence variables and derived a discriminant function F1; a regression of EPI versus F1 was fitted (R2=0.9029 for SCPU) and used to obtain the EPI baseline, adjusted to actual external influence conditions.
baseline_construction_method.evidence_quote: In our case a Discriminant Function Analysis (DFA) technique is selected to extract key influence variables (KIVs) from PIV and model EPI against these variables
